headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 19, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jones pitched 5.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run. The Chicago Cubs also secured a win, taking down the Minnesota Twins 6-2 with Matthew Boyd earning the win. Kody Clemens led the Twins' offense with two home runs and two RBIs.

Several players are dealing with injuries, including Will Vest, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list by the Detroit Tigers due to right posterior elbow inflammation. The Washington Nationals have placed PJ Poulin on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 16, 2026, due to a left flexor strain. Richard Lovelady has been transferred to the 60-day injured list by the Washington Nationals due to a left triceps strain.

The Chicago Cubs acquired RHP Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for RHP Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles acquired RF Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals in exchange for cash. The St. Louis Cardinals acquired RHP Trey Pooser from the Tampa Bay Rays, and the Pittsburgh Pirates acquired CF Robert Hassell III from the Washington Nationals in exchange for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jones pitched 5.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Guardians in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, snapping the Pirates' winning streak. Travis Bazzana led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key 8th-inning homer that scored Steven Kwan.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Twins 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 6-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Matthew Boyd earning the win. Kody Clemens led the Twins' offense with two home runs and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Shut Down Mets 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 6-1 victory over the New York Mets, with Jesús Luzardo earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Trea Turner led the Mets' offense with a 3-hit performance, including a home run.

top_news.title: **White Sox Shut Out Blue Jays 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a shutout victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with a final score of 3-0. Impact players for the White Sox included Colson Montgomery, Braden Montgomery, and Nathan Lukes, while Trey Yesavage had a standout performance on the mound.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Dominate Yankees in 8-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured an 8-2 win over the New York Yankees, with Shohei Ohtani and Max Muncy leading the charge for the Dodgers.

top_news.title: **Vest Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers right-handed pitcher Will Vest has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right posterior elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Aaron Civale in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett.
